title: The Last of Us Part I
summary: Experimental native-HDR PsychoV, RenoDRT, and NeuTwo tone mapping for The Last of Us Part I.
notes: Requires Windows HDR and the in-game HDR output option.
Initial shader and descriptor-layout support targets game version 1.1.5.0.
Version 1.1.4.0 and other builds require separate capture validation.
